title: SLASH · the cover
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The digest cover for Noir Week: a trench coat under the Lanes' neon, in rain, played straight. No signature. No gull. The strip pretending to be the novel for one week.

panels.composition: A single image: a man in a trench coat, collar up, hat brim down, under the bowling alley's neon at night in rain, the sign's pink and blue in the puddles. Heavy black. No face. Unsigned.

characters.pose: trench coat, collar up, face hidden

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a zine cover of a man in a trench coat with his collar up and hat brim down standing under a bowling alley's neon sign at night in rain, the neon reflected in puddles, heavy black spotting, played completely straight, no words
image.notes: Unsigned. No gull. The title SLASH lettered across the top after, in a hand-cut display face.

art.line: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white

notes: Unsigned cover. The novel's name on the strip's cover, once.
